question:
**Direction: Select the correct word for the blanks in the given sentence.**

He has a ______ nature and the rainforest is a ______ of forest found on earth.
solution:
The correct answer is** "kind."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires an adjective to describe the nature of the person mentioned.
 
• For the first blank, **"Kind"** is a suitable word to describe a person's nature as it means having a friendly, generous, and considerate attitude. (परोपकारी; मित्रवत और उदार)
 
 
• **Example**: *He is very **kind**__.*
 
 
 
• ​The second part of the sentence mentions a specific type of forest, which is the rainforest.
 
• **"Kind" **means a group whose members all have the same qualities. (समान गुणों वाले व्यक्तियों का समूह; वर्ग)
 __
 
• **Example**: *There are people of all **kinds**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

**Correct sentence**: *He has a __**kind**__ nature and the rainforest is a __**kind**__ of forest found on earth.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (type)** is not a suitable word to describe a person's nature and is not related to the second part of the sentence. (समान विशेषताओं वाले व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं का समूह (जो अपने से बड़े समूह का भाग हो); प्रकार या क़िस्‍म)
 
• **Option 2 (caring)** is a suitable word to describe a person's nature, but it does not match the context of the second part of the sentence. (दूसरों के प्रति चिंता और प्‍यार दिखानेवाला; परचिंतक)
 
• **Option 4 (rude)** is the opposite of what is required to describe the person's nature and does not match the context of the second part of the sentence. (अशिष्‍ट (किसी के प्रति) (किसी बात पर))
